# Cheshire Trade Centre

> Cheshire Trade Centre is an independent used car dealer in Chester, Cheshire. We offer finance from 10.4% APR (representative 19.9% APR), welcome part exchange, and include a minimum 3-month warranty with every car.

Based at Parkgate Road, Chester, CH1 4AY, we offer finance (credit broker, not a lender), part exchange, and a minimum 3-month warranty with extended 6 and 12 month options.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.cheshiretradecentre.co.uk/): current stock overview, latest arrivals and highlights
- [Stock](https://www.cheshiretradecentre.co.uk/stock.php): filter used cars by make, model, body type, fuel, price and mileage
- [Vehicle finance](https://www.cheshiretradecentre.co.uk/finance.php): HP/PCP finance from 10.4% APR, representative 19.9% APR, subject to status
- [Sell your car](https://www.cheshiretradecentre.co.uk/sell-your-car.php): sell or part-exchange your car
- [Warranty](https://www.cheshiretradecentre.co.uk/warranty.php): minimum 3-month warranty and extended cover options
- [Reviews](https://www.cheshiretradecentre.co.uk/reviews.php): verified customer reviews
- [About us](https://www.cheshiretradecentre.co.uk/about-us.php): independent dealer serving Chester and Cheshire
- [Contact](https://www.cheshiretradecentre.co.uk/contact.php): call 0800 917 4622 or visit our Chester showroom
- [FAQ](https://www.cheshiretradecentre.co.uk/faq.php): buying, finance, warranty and part exchange questions
- [Buyers guide](https://www.cheshiretradecentre.co.uk/buyers-guide.php): step-by-step used car buying advice
- [Privacy policy](https://www.cheshiretradecentre.co.uk/privacy.php)
- [Complaints policy](https://www.cheshiretradecentre.co.uk/complaints-policy.php)
